sections.heading: About Me
body: I’m Dylan, a UX/UI and product designer and a final-year Bachelor of Design / Media student at UNSW, specialising in Graphics and Interaction and in PR and Advertising.

I believe design is more than aesthetics: it has the power to make everyday things easier for people. I love solving problems with research, testing and iteration, and I value working closely with others to find solutions that really address the problem.
I also bring AI into my process, from producing campaign assets with AI tools to building this portfolio with an AI coding agent, while keeping the design decisions human.

sections.heading: Highlights
body: – IBM: delivered 40+ campaign visuals and videos explaining AI and quantum concepts, using Figma and IBM Bob, and launched “Dylan Does…”, an internal workshop series that upskills colleagues.
– Process Creative: designed and iterated interface components, personas and user journeys for 4 retainer clients, with annotated prototypes for clear developer handoff.
– OpenOnion: ran usability testing and interviews for a Chrome extension, cutting task completion time by 30% through iterative design while keeping to WCAG standards.
